CAPACITOR FALLBACK CODE
// @capacitor-community/bluetooth-le
import { BleClient } from '@capacitor-community/bluetooth-le'
await BleClient.initialize()
const device = await BleClient.requestDevice({ optionalServices: [...] })

// @capacitor-community/health
import { Health } from '@capacitor-community/health'
const available = await Health.isAvailable()
await Health.requestPermissions({ read: ['heart_rate','steps','sleep'] })
const hr = await Health.queryAggregated({ dataType: 'heart_rate', ... })
